spec: §15 suite A (effects); §7.3 device models: entropy read copies tape bytes, console write appends, clock read writes c then c+=1, block write/read move a 512-byte sector; each effect appends (dev, op, args) to the effect tape
derivation: Entropy bytes 0b 16 21 land at the allocation (heap_base=16 in the layout, alloc returns the bump, §7.1); console echoes them (console_hex 0b1621); clock.read overwrites with its initial 0 and becomes 1; sector 7 is written then read back, so the loaded i64 is 0. Five tape entries in program order; 11 instructions in total.
